claims.claim: IDPhoto Pro is an iPhone app that prepares passport, visa, and ID photo files.
claims.caveat: The app prepares photo files only; it does not create or verify official documents.

claims.claim: Core photo processing happens on device and photos are not uploaded to a server for editing.
claims.caveat: Recheck after adding any cloud, analytics, or third-party photo-processing service.

claims.claim: The product uses a one-time unlock rather than a subscription and has no advertising.
claims.caveat: Pricing and availability can vary by storefront; do not state a price without storefront evidence.

claims.claim: IDPhoto Pro supports 100+ photo size presets.
claims.caveat: The repository contains 113 preset records. Confirm released-app parity before approval.

claims.claim: Each generated country or document photo page states a current size, pixel target, and background requirement.
claims.scope: approximately 87 generated pages derived from app-photo-specs.ts
claims.owner: 增长运营 / 产品经理
claims.caveat: The 113-row source dataset has no per-row authority URL, reviewed date, market scope, or evidence owner.

claims.claim: IDPhoto Pro can guarantee acceptance of a prepared photo.
claims.caveat: This claim must remain prohibited; final acceptance belongs to the receiving authority.
